_meta.method: twoway per probe under the named scheme; the graph object's rows, cols, holes, key holes, style switches, l1/b1/r1 title text, overall legend and colour key draw_view and relative_position, and per panel the draw_view of its y, x and y2 axes, their titles, its legend and colour key; label boxes from the rects written just before each panel label's text in the SVG export
